title: Insufficient PBKDF2 iterations
remediation: Use at least 10000 iterations and tune upward for the deployment environment.

evidence.code: PBKDF2HMAC(algorithm = hashes.SHA1(), length = 32, salt = enc_salt, iterations = 1000, backend = default_backend())

title: Encryption without authentication
message: Encryption has no associated ciphertext authentication operation in its resolved scope.
remediation: Use an AEAD mode or authenticate the ciphertext with a MAC.
